title: Continuation plan and missing work
summary: The immediate gaps are dev11 r13196 service qualification, promotion of the unpacked GitHub provider tree from dev7.1 to dev11, durable Queue Fabric submission through Relationship CRM Service, SIP UAC/originating INVITE, richer Interaction Event projection and guarded Odoo collection mutation commands.
invariants: Do not make Queue Fabric a mandatory dependency of the Odoo provider; service submission belongs at the Relationship CRM Service boundary.
Do not implement outbound calling by pretending REGISTER-only SipClient already originates INVITE.
Do not flatten OdooObject provider evidence when Relationship CRM or Interaction Event can retain a typed reference.
Do not enable one2many/many2many mutation without explicit locally declared Odoo command semantics.
Do not let intention discovery become mutation authority.
The exact dev11 release archive may be published before the unpacked GitHub source tree is promoted; never describe the stale unpacked tree as dev11 until byte-verified.
procedure: Run the new dev11 service integration regression under r13196 and record the result.
Promote packages/oorexx_odoo_crm_provider from the exact dev11 release archive into the unpacked GitHub source tree and verify MANIFEST.sha256 before calling the source tree current.
Add a service submission adapter only against the existing Relationship CRM Service Queue/Queue Fabric contract.
Implement and qualify SIP originating INVITE as a separate SIP workstream, then bind CRM destination preparation to it.
Extend Interaction Event projection only where the canonical event model supplies evidence not already represented by SIP/CRM objects.
